open_points.subject: Repair view (A15 rule 6) selection of NodeExecutions
open_points.text: "pages the NodeExecutions whose executed implementation is in that set"
open_points.question: Should the repair view include function-node NodeExecutions with status `skipped_by_guard` or `upstream_failed` (where `executed` is absent), or only records that name an executed implementation?
options: Include all function-node NodeExecutions for the slot’s contract versions (including skipped/upstream_failed) by joining through run->flow node contract version
Include only NodeExecutions that carry an executed implementation id
open_points.default_guess: Include only NodeExecutions with an executed implementation, because that is the filtering method explicitly described.

open_points.subject: Unknown-reference refusal responsibility boundary
open_points.question: Who performs the existence check that must happen before record-specific checks (A16 rule 1): `surface` via direct store reads per operation, or each owning module with `surface` only mapping a typed not-found result?
options: `surface` pre-checks referenced record existence directly (possibly via `store`) before calling operation modules
Owning modules perform existence checks and return a standardized not-found result that `surface` maps to unknown-reference refusal
open_points.default_guess: Owning modules check existence and return standardized not-found errors; `surface` maps them to the single unknown-reference refusal.
